objective: Useful contributed computation improves shared lexicon resources, benefits modest devices and outside projects, and supports demand-scaled video and independently operated networks.
state_meaning: States refer to implementation. Preparing or validating the plan does not pass its implementation gates.

missions.requirement: Useful modest-device contribution and a direct benefit beyond credits
Pooled work improves a shared lexicon with measured value from sharing and pooling separately
An outside application reuses the resource and avoids repeated work
Demand changes completed video preparation/distribution work and improves equal-quality playback economics
Workers choose other projects and independent networks exchange compatible resources while retaining policy
Understandable, trustworthy, reproducible demonstration with recoverable state and truthful release claims

packets.title: Trustworthy repaired checkpoint
packets.first_action: Preserve the current diff and reproduce the bounded mutation timeout and task settlement failure boundaries.
acceptance: Mutation timeouts and collection errors cannot count as detections
Local accounting survives declared concurrency/retry/process-failure cases
Required checks, installed-wheel smoke outside checkout, and browser journey have current evidence
Legacy acceptance requirements and product story are reconciled without weakening intended behavior
packets.stop_or_replan: Separate unrelated failures into bounded follow-up work; do not claim a final all-green checkpoint until required failures are resolved.

packets.title: Measurement and simulation boundaries
packets.first_action: Create a known-byte transfer between isolated sender and receiver stores and account for every repair and control message.
acceptance: Local deduplication counters are distinguished from actual byte traffic
Unavailable sender data cannot appear as free recovery
Measured link totals match the known workload, including retries and control overhead
Simulation, actual transport and hardware scope are explicit
packets.stop_or_replan: Invalidate any performance claim whose accounting cannot be reconciled; repair instrumentation before optimization.

packets.title: Workload, hardware and success contract
packets.first_action: Inventory permitted records and available hardware; define source/time splits, reuse/update traces and frozen practical limits.
acceptance: Corpus provenance, permitted sharing and exact hashes are recorded
Training, tuning and final evaluation sources are separated
Baseline and benefit/resource thresholds are frozen before final evaluation
Missing adopter/hardware evidence is labelled exploratory rather than fabricated
packets.stop_or_replan: Prepare proxies while external input is missing; do not turn proxy results into adoption or actual-device claims.

packets.title: Artifact identity and safe lifecycle
packets.first_action: Define typed immutable artifact IDs, canonical manifests and an independently authorized active-version selection.
acceptance: Wrong-root updates reject without changing active state
Selection changes are authenticated and cannot silently roll back
Version and canonical serialization boundary cases are covered
Dependency closure is bounded, retained and recoverable; malformed paths/recipes reject before unsafe access or allocation
Raw content and recipe identities cannot be silently interchanged
packets.stop_or_replan: Do not integrate distributed artifact selection until mismatches, identity ambiguity and recovery are resolved.

packets.title: Shared-resource value and lexicon candidate decision
packets.first_action: Run the E1 A/B comparison with an established dictionary implementation and competitive baseline.
acceptance: Held-out comparison includes cold/warm clients, updates, eviction and all distribution costs
Exact reconstruction and negative controls succeed within declared limits
Practical shared-resource benefit meets the frozen contract
E2 next-candidate decision preserves the wider lexicon mechanism; dictionary success is not a full generative-lexicon claim
packets.stop_or_replan: A failed candidate is recorded as verification_failed; diagnose and test a justified alternative with fresh evaluation discipline, not a renamed success.
packets.execution_note: Formal G4 is unverified and dependencies remain open. A standalone exploratory candidate was screened; its result does not classify the full lexicon or this work packet as failed.

candidate_results.scope: Central 1 KiB Zstandard dictionary on project-doc proxy; 6.1% versus frozen 10% cold-client threshold at 100 records

packets.title: One useful bounded worker job
packets.first_action: Add one reviewed built-in artifact-producing recipe with explicit inputs, algorithm, result bytes, validation and budgets.
acceptance: A separate worker produces a useful artifact consumed by the pipeline
Copied expected hashes alone cannot satisfy output validation
Time/memory/output limits, cancellation, attempts and backpressure are enforced
Generation and verification overhead and locality are measured
packets.stop_or_replan: If the recipe cannot fit the measured device or validation dominates utility, redesign the job before generalizing the scheduler.

packets.title: Durable result installation and settlement
packets.first_action: Separate result validation/publication from reward effects and define recoverable participant entitlements.
acceptance: Fault injection covers candidate write, reference commit, acceptance, entitlement and reward persistence
Exactly one policy-entitled effect survives retries and process failure for every eligible participant
Supply, receipts, balances and job state reconcile
Useful artifact remains valid and accessible when rewards are disabled or unavailable
packets.stop_or_replan: Do not use a shared lock as proof of crash atomicity; retain incomplete work and repair the durable recovery protocol.

packets.title: Useful pooling and actual modest-device evidence
packets.first_action: Run E1 C/B and E3 on a measured supported modest device with a separate consuming client.
acceptance: Pooling meets a frozen practical constraint and all total-cost/participant budgets
Actual device identity, memory, responsiveness, cancellation and failure behavior are recorded
A direct contributor or recipient benefit beyond credits is measured
Unmeasured phone/sensor behavior is not generalized from labels or throttling
packets.stop_or_replan: Sharing benefit without pooling benefit does not pass G6; change the pooled job or locality assumptions and retain negative results.

packets.title: Independent application reuse
packets.first_action: Build the smallest separate client that discovers, verifies and consumes the artifact without demo internals.
acceptance: Separate installation does not share database, secret or internal imports
Compatible versions work; unsupported requirements fail or use explicit fallback
Dependency eviction and restoration retain exact output
Avoided work and integration effort are recorded against the existing workflow
packets.stop_or_replan: If consuming the artifact costs more than using the ordinary workflow, reduce integration surface and revisit the value proposition.

packets.title: Demand causes bounded completed work
packets.first_action: Wire one real request window to one budgeted preparation/replication job and its completed availability result.
acceptance: Demand windows age out old requests and deduplicate retries
Threshold, cooldown, hysteresis and quotas bound job amplification
Declining demand cancels obsolete work and retires excess replicas
Cold/niche content retains declared service and cache hits do not erase all demand visibility
packets.stop_or_replan: A slot or queued job alone is not evidence of delivery improvement; trace completion and later consumption.

packets.title: Demand-scaled video evidence
packets.first_action: Run E4 with a permitted clip, separate delivery nodes, real player clients and explicit simulated load.
acceptance: Equal-quality ordinary-cache comparison includes aligned/unaligned viewers, bursts, seeks and churn
Origin and aggregate traffic, control/repair work, startup and stalls are measured
Every repair comes from an explicit available source and full loss without a source fails within budget
Chosen scaling mechanism shows declared practical value; media coding/broadcast claims are scoped to actual evidence
packets.stop_or_replan: Lower origin traffic with excessive peer cost or worse playback does not establish the intended benefit.

packets.title: Independent-network resource federation
packets.first_action: Exchange one artifact between separately configured networks and a separately authored consumer with explicit peering policy.
acceptance: No shared database or implicit secret/authority shortcut
Partition/rejoin, namespace collisions, version negotiation and missing dependencies are covered
Content exchange does not import remote minting or local update authority
Peering exit, quotas and loop suppression work
packets.stop_or_replan: Keep the first ledger boundary local; cross-network money/supply semantics require an explicit separately verified policy.

packets.title: Enforced external-job execution boundary
packets.first_action: Prove actual runtime limits before enabling code supplied by another project; keep unsupported code execution disabled.
acceptance: Production execution cannot fall back to a mock success
Infinite loops, memory growth, oversized output and forbidden host operations are bounded in the real backend
Runtime identity, compatibility and measured overhead are recorded
Host-call timeouts and capabilities are tested independently of Wasm fuel
packets.stop_or_replan: If the runtime is unavailable or unenforceable, leave arbitrary code disabled and state that the full extensible-runtime gate is incomplete.

packets.title: Other-project participation and incentive boundaries
packets.first_action: Let a worker opt into a second project's approved jobs and verify refusal, cancellation, quota and settlement isolation.
acceptance: Project opt-in and resource boundaries are enforceable
Copied hashes, duplicate outputs and colluding identities do not qualify as demonstrated useful independent work
Trust assumptions and probabilistic verification limits are explicit
Participant entitlements and network accounting cannot leak across project boundaries
packets.stop_or_replan: Do not promote local software identity into permissionless or hardware-backed trust; preserve the explicit trust boundary until verified.

packets.title: Complete mission pilot and reviewable release
packets.first_action: Audit every mission requirement against current scoped evidence and obtain an independent reproduction of the complete pilot.
acceptance: M1-M6 each have appropriate evidence with no failed or missing required gate
Migration, interruption, recovery, fresh installation and rollback behavior are demonstrated
User demonstration exposes actual work, invalid-result rejection, shared reuse, video demand and network interoperability
Source/artifacts/tests and claims match; normal commit/push/release follows the applicable authorization
packets.stop_or_replan: Ship only accurately scoped intermediate checkpoints while full mission evidence is incomplete; do not relabel the checkpoint as the final research outcome.
